purpose: Teach: 熊野/小澤/杉田/菅原/豊島/志村/川原/清原

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと熊野古道を歩く旅行を計画されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is planning a trip to walk the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage trail with you.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Gentle leading quality—sharing something she's noticed. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to engage. Steady, present tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと音楽家小澤征爾のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about the conductor Ozawa Seiji.
lines.style: Quiet excitement. Eager to share something special. Slight breathlessness on the name. Simple, direct delivery—no embellishment needed. Small genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「杉田玄白の医学書」のお話を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told you about Sugita Genpaku's medical writings, didn't he.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Not quite a question, more like she's turning the moment over in her mind. Noticing the pattern of what his father does. Warm recognition underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと天神様、つまり菅原道真の歴史を学んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me about Sugawara no Michizane—you know, Tenjin. The god of scholarship.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly formal in his delivery. Proud to share what he's learned. Clear enunciation. A child choosing his words carefully because the subject matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「豊島区の祖父の家に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting to visit your grandfather's place in Toshima Ward.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing. Gentle observational tone. A slight pause before 'Toshima Ward'—like she's remembering him say it. Steady maternal attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと志村けんの笑いの動画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a video of Shimura Ken's comedy sketches.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded pleasure. Quick delivery. Delight in the shared laughter. Genuine amusement still sitting in the voice. Relaxed and open.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「川原の散歩は気持ちいい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said that a walk along the riverbed feels really nice.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective pause. Almost to herself first, then to him. Noticing the simple wisdom in what his father said. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと野球の清原のホームラン集観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a compilation of home runs by Kiyohara—the baseball player.
lines.style: Eager, bright close. Forward momentum. Pleasure in the detail—he remembers the name. Quick, energetic delivery. Genuine enthusiasm carrying through to the end.
